name: Ouka
source:
The last descendant of a line of mystical protectors, Yuuya Furusaka has received the twin blessing of Life and Death, and now his touch has the power to save lifes or destroy them, although at the price of, respectively, his own life or his own soul.
But maybe the key for his salvation is hidden in one of the girls around him...

Officially released as a remake of [url=/v2100]Shinkirou[/url], Ouka is more an alternative version than a real remake. Not only the artwork and the musics are entirely redone, the original story too has been vastly expanded (and often modified), and also includes new routes, new characters and new winnable heroines.
translation:
古坂悠也是神秘守护者一族的最后后裔。他同时得到生命与死亡的祝福，如今，他的触碰既能拯救生命，也能将其毁灭；相应的代价分别是他自己的生命与灵魂。
然而，拯救他的关键或许就隐藏在身边某个少女身上…

《樱华》官方以[url=/v2100]《蜃气楼》[/url]重制版的名义发行，但与其说是真正的重制，不如说是另一种版本。不仅美术与音乐完全重做，原作故事也得到大幅扩展（且经常修改），还加入新路线、新角色及新的可攻略女主角。
